head_commit.message:
Expand native models, tensor operations, tokenizers and context ABI

Load pretrained Mamba-1 and BPE/Q4_K_M models through the native Rust facade. Add Unigram, RWKV and PLaMo tokenizers, extend CPU graphs to 62 operation IDs, and implement 184 of 255 frozen C exports including bounded context/memory/session operations.

Retain independent native fixtures, failures and Windows/Linux evidence. Fix full-batch transient KV accounting before committing state. The full-port release gate remains explicitly blocked.
